title: French Technical Translation Services - BeTranslated
metaDescription: French technical translation for engineering, construction and IT: manuals, specifications and datasheets by subject-matter translators. Request a free quote.
bodyHtml:
French technical translation services

Technical documents need translators who understand the subject as well as the language.

Engineering and IT documents

We translate manuals, specifications, datasheets and user guides for engineering and construction and for IT and telecoms, between French and English.

Subject-matter translators

Frédéric, one of our French technical translators, studied industrial engineering and worked for 10 years as a systems engineer. He specialises in technical, IT and tourism translation.

Our professional translators are matched to your subject and your language pair.

Contact us today for a free, no-obligation quote.
